grpck-help.stdout:
Usage: grpck [options] [group [gshadow]]

Options:
  -h, --help                    display this help message and exit
  -r, --read-only               display errors and warnings
                                but do not change files
  -R, --root CHROOT_DIR         directory to chroot into
  -s, --sort                    sort entries by UID
  -S, --silence-warnings        silence controversial/paranoid warnings

rc=0

grpck-read-only-bad-field-count.stdout:
invalid group file entry
delete line 'dev:x:50'? No
grpck: no changes
rc=2

grpck-read-only-duplicate.stdout:
duplicate group entry
delete line 'dev:x:50:'? No
duplicate group entry
delete line 'dev:x:51:'? No
grpck: no changes
rc=2

grpck-read-only-gshadow-orphan.stdout:
no matching group file entry in gr
delete line 'ghost:!::'? No
grpck: no changes
rc=2

group dev: no user ghost
delete member 'ghost'? No
grpck: no changes
rc=2
